SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name, 
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM 
    trans t
JOIN 
    account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    t.type = 'VYDAJ' 
    AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY 
    d.A2
ORDER BY 
    total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name, 
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM 
    trans t
JOIN 
    account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    t.type = 'VYDAJ' 
    AND t.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-01-31'
GROUP BY 
    d.A2
ORDER BY 
    total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT name 
FROM sets 
WHERE code NOT IN (
    SELECT setCode 
    FROM set_translations 
    WHERE language LIKE '%Japanese%'
) 
AND code IN (
    SELECT setCode 
    FROM set_translations 
    WHERE language = 'Korean'
)

SELECT T1.name 
FROM sets AS T1 
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode AND T2.language = 'Japanese' 
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T3 ON T1.code = T3.setCode AND T3.language = 'Korean' 
WHERE T2.id IS NULL AND T3.id IS NOT NULL

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM 
    Laboratory
JOIN 
    Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE 
    Patient.Birthday = '1959-02-18'

SELECT 
    (MAX(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', Date) = '1981-12' THEN T_BIL END) - MIN(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', Date) = '1981-11' THEN T_BIL END)) / 
    MIN(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', Date) = '1981-11' THEN T_BIL END) AS decrease_rate
FROM 
    Laboratory
JOIN 
    Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE 
    Patient.Birthday = '1959-02-18'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, P.Description, P.`First Date`, P.Admission, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', L.Date) = '1991-10'
  AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, P.Description, P.`First Date`, P.Admission, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-' 
  AND L.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-31'
  AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Thrombosis = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.ID) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%'
